mapper.select: SELECT id, name, source_year, question_count FROM paper ORDER BY source_year
SELECT id, name, source_year, question_count FROM paper WHERE id = #{paperId} LIMIT 1

SELECT q.id AS question_id, q.question_type, q.source_question_no, q.current_version_no, q.current_version_id AS version_id, s.name AS subject_name, q.stem_html, q.assets_json FROM paper p JOIN question q ON JSON_CONTAINS(p.question_ids, CAST(q.id AS JSON)) LEFT JOIN subject s ON s.id = q.subject_id WHERE p.id = #{paperId} ORDER BY CAST(q.source_question_no AS UNSIGNED)

SELECT q.id AS question_id, q.question_type, q.current_version_no, q.stem_html, q.assets_json, q.source_year, q.source_question_no, s.name AS subject_name FROM question q LEFT JOIN subject s ON s.id = q.subject_id WHERE q.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM question WHERE id IN #{v}
SELECT bind_group, MIN(bound_at) AS bound_at FROM answer_bind WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND paper_id = #{paperId} AND status = 'active' AND bind_group IS NOT NULL GROUP BY bind_group LIMIT 1

SELECT b.id, b.question_id, b.version_id, b.version_no, b.bind_token, b.question_type, b.pending_manual, v.stem_html, v.assets_json FROM answer_bind b JOIN question_version v ON v.id = b.version_id WHERE b.student_id = #{studentId} AND b.bind_group = #{bindGroup} AND b.status = 'active' ORDER BY CAST(b.question_id AS UNSIGNED)
SELECT bind_group, SUM(status = 'submitted') AS submitted_count, COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM answer_bind WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND bind_group = #{bindGroup} GROUP BY bind_group LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO answer_bind (bind_token, question_id, version_id, version_no, status, student_id, paper_id, bind_group, question_type, pending_manual) VALUES (#{b.bind_token}, #{b.question_id}, #{b.version_id}, #{b.version_no}, 'active', #{b.student_id}, #{b.paper_id}, #{b.bind_group}, #{b.question_type}, #{b.pending_manual})
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.question_id, b.version_no, b.answer_text, b.status, b.pending_manual, b.question_type, v.stem_html, v.analysis_html, v.correct, v.assets_json, q.source_question_no, s.name AS subject_name FROM answer_bind b JOIN question_version v ON v.id = b.version_id JOIN question q ON q.id = b.question_id LEFT JOIN subject s ON s.id = q.subject_id WHERE b.student_id = #{studentId} AND b.bind_group = #{bindGroup} ORDER BY CAST(b.question_id AS UNSIGNED)
mapper.update: UPDATE answer_bind SET status = 'submitted', answer_text = #{answerText}, pending_manual = #{pendingManual}, submitted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
